thanks.title: Thanks — we've got your application.
thanks.body: We review every Ambassador application by hand and usually follow up within a few business days. We'll email you either way.

items.question: Who can join Mindsetis?
items.answer: Mindsetis is an exclusive network for business owners, founders, and C-level executives. We review every application to maintain a high-caliber community and ensure relevant exchange of experience

items.question: How does the application and vetting process work?
items.answer: After you click Apply to Join, our team reviews your professional background (LinkedIn, company profile) and schedules a brief intro call to confirm your eligibility.

items.question: What are the membership conditions and pricing?
items.answer: Joining Mindsetis is completely free for the first year, including registration, profile creation, and using your personal page. Sessions and events can be either free or paid, as set individually by the hosts. Additionally, Mindsetis hosts a free weekly P2P networking event open to all community members.

items.question: How do 1-on-1 sessions with Mindsetters work?
items.answer: Use our AI search bar or category filters to find a mentor with the exact experience you need, pick an available slot in their calendar, and book your session directly.

items.question: Can I become a Mindsetter (mentor) on the platform?
items.answer: Yes. If you are a proven founder or executive willing to share actionable insights, you can apply to become a Mindsetter through your profile settings.

items.question: What types of events does Mindsetis host?
items.answer: Our formats include focused Masterminds, interactive P2P sessions, informal Never Eat Alone & SENSESSION meetups, and we are planning much more activities with a platform growth.

items.name: Erin Glabets
items.quote: Recientemente asistí a la sesión de Anastasia sobre Marketing de Eventos, y realmente superó mis expectativas. Tiene un talento poco común para desglosar estrategias complejas en pasos claros y accionables que puedes aplicar de inmediato. Tres meses después, sigo usando el marco de trabajo que compartió.

items.name: Daniel Kovalenko
items.quote: Una de las horas más útiles que he invertido este año. Anastasia nos guió por todo el proceso de producción de conferencias — concepto, escenario, guion — y me fui con una lista que usé la semana siguiente.

items.name: Mira Torres
items.quote: Anastasia me preparó antes de mi primera keynote y cambió por completo mi forma de pensar sobre la presencia en el escenario. Sin relleno, solo comentarios prácticos y reales que marcaron una diferencia inmediata.

items.name: Oksana Petrenko
items.quote: Llegué con una marca personal dispersa y me fui con un plan real. Anastasia hace las preguntas correctas y no te deja conformarte con respuestas genéricas. Justo lo que necesitaba antes de nuestra ronda de financiación.

items.name: Lucas Meyer
items.quote: Trabajar con Anastasia en la estrategia creativa para el lanzamiento de nuestro producto fue la mejor decisión que tomamos ese trimestre. Ella crea formatos con los que la gente realmente quiere interactuar, no otra campaña más que nadie recuerda.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Mindsetis collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal data when you use our website, mobile applications, and related services (collectively, the "Platform").

blocks.text: Mindsetis is a registered trademark owned by Anastasiia Kondratska (an individual). The Platform is operated, and data processing is managed, by Sole Proprietor (FOP) Kondratska, registered under the laws of Ukraine. Sole Proprietor Kondratska acts as the Data Controller (or "Business" under U.S. laws) for your personal data.
For any privacy-related inquiries, data requests, or to exercise your rights, please contact our Privacy Officer at privacy@mindsetis.com.
We collect personal information directly from you, automatically through your device, and from select third parties:

items: Account Data: Name, email address, password hash, language preferences, and timezone.
Profile & Public Data: Profile photo, professional role, company, location, and any information you voluntarily publish in your profile.
Verification Data: Identity verification is conducted by our third-party verification providers. We only receive and store the verification result (e.g., "verified"), never your identity documents.
Booking & Interaction Data: Details of sessions, events, requests, and messages sent through the Platform.
Payment Data: Payment transactions are processed securely by independent payment processors (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). We do not collect, store, or process complete credit card numbers.
Technical & Usage Data: IP address, device type, operating system, browser settings, and cookie data as specified in our Cookies Policy.

sections.heading: Legal Bases for Processing & How We Use Data

blocks.text: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

items: Contractual Necessity: To create and manage your account, facilitate bookings, process transactions, and provide Platform functionality.
Legitimate Interests: To ensure Platform security, verify real users, prevent fraud, improve our services, and analyze usage trends.
Consent: To send marketing communications, conduct non-essential analytics, or deploy non-essential cookies. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
Legal Compliance: To comply with applicable tax, accounting, and legal obligations.

blocks.text: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with authorized Service Providers bound by strict data protection agreements:

items: Infrastructure & Hosting: Cloud servers and technical infrastructure.
Communication & Calls: Google Meet, Zoom, or email notification providers.
Payment & Verification: Payment gateways (Stripe) and identity verification partners.
Analytics: Privacy-compliant analytics providers (subject to your cookie preferences).

blocks.text: Because our operations and service providers are located globally, your personal data may be transferred to, and stored in, countries outside your state, province, or country of residence (including Ukraine, the United States, and the EEA).

Where required by applicable law (e.g., GDPR, UK GDPR), we ensure international transfers are protected by standard contractual safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) adopted by the European Commission or adequacy decisions.
We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy or as required by law:

items: Active Accounts: Data is kept for the duration of your active account.
Account Deletion: Upon account deletion, personal profile and account data are purged from our active systems within 30 days.
Legal Obligations: Financial and transactional records are retained for the statutory period required for tax, accounting, and anti-fraud purposes (typically 3–5 years).

blocks.text: Depending on your place of residence, you may have the following legal rights regarding your personal data:
A. European Economic Area (EEA), UK & Swiss Residents (GDPR / UK GDPR)

items: Access, Rectification & Erasure: The right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data ("Right to be Forgotten").
Portability & Restriction: The right to request a copy of your data in a structured format or restrict its processing.
Withdrawal of Consent & Objection: The right to withdraw consent at any time or object to processing based on legitimate interests.
Supervisory Authority: The right to lodge a complaint with your local Data Protection Authority (DPA).

blocks.text: B. United States Residents (CCPA / CPRA & State Privacy Laws)

items: Right to Know & Access: Request details regarding the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected.
No Sale / No Sharing of Personal Data: We do not sell or share your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising as defined by the CCPA/CPRA.
Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your privacy rights.

blocks.text: C. Canadian Residents (PIPEDA)
You have the right to access your personal data, challenge its accuracy, and withdraw consent for data collection or processing at any time.

How to Exercise Your Rights: To exercise any of these rights, please email us at privacy@mindsetis.com. We will respond to verified requests within statutory timeframes (30 days for GDPR, 45 days for CCPA).

The Platform is not directed to individuals under the age of 18 (or the age of legal majority in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we learn that we have collected personal data from a minor without parental consent, we will delete it immediately.

We implement industry-standard technical, organizational, and physical security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or disclosure. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect legal or operational changes. If we make material updates, we will notify you by email or via a notice on the Platform at least 14 days before the changes take effect.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookies Policy
intro: This policy explains what cookies Mindsetis uses, what each of them does, and how you can change your choice at any time.

blocks.text: A cookie is a small file a website stores on your device. It lets the site remember you between visits — that you are logged in, which language you chose, what you already dismissed.
These keep the site working and cannot be switched off. They hold your session, protect forms from abuse and remember your cookie choice itself.
Legal basis: our legitimate interest in running a secure service. Consent is not required.
These remember your preferences — interface language, timezone, whether a banner was closed. Turning them off means telling us the same things again on every visit.
These tell us which pages people open and where they stop, so we can fix what does not work. The data is aggregated and never used to identify you personally.
Set only with your consent.
These measure whether an ad brought someone to Mindsetis. We do not sell your data and we do not build advertising profiles.
Set only with your consent.
Some cookies come from services we rely on:

items: Stripe — payment processing and fraud prevention.
Google — authentication and video calls.
Our analytics provider — aggregated usage statistics.

blocks.text: Open Cookie settings in the footer at any time to change what you allow. You can also clear cookies in your browser, though that will log you out.
